name: efad435cee5c
claim: Internal-classified project materials (handoffs, working folders, workbooks, clones and anything derived from them) stay off every repository, pull request, issue, commit message, lesson and memory file; only the data-free handoff and its checksummed bundle may be referenced by path and category, and nothing is pushed or published unless the operator explicitly commands that exact push or publish.

decisions.notes: Broadcast to all local agents during the EEG pickup; the rule restates the operator boundary already enforced on the public-side audit and adds the explicit push/publish gate.

rationale: Internal materials must never leak through memory, lessons or automation; sharing requires an explicit operator command naming the artifact.
